ignored_remaining_policy: Unreviewed files remain ignored, contents not inspected/certified; no blanket force-add.
self_exclusion: INDEX-AUDIT.json cannot include its own hash; final verifier checks its exact disk/index bytes, outside final-head receipt binds SHA256.
force_add_policy: Every path individually allowlisted/scanned; PNGs manually reviewed; one explicit path per add, including non-ignored paths for consistency. No directory or ignored log glob added.
